title: why are meterBG's not synchronized in NS-Follower mode
body:
Hi

we are using an Accu-Chek Guide via bluetooth and synchonize the BG records to your nightscout instance. Thats running very well and in the mongodb we see all the metering as type "mbg".
Now i set up a NS-Follower and encountered that all our meterBG's aren't synchronized to the follower. Looking at the code it turned out, that even all events (including mbg's) are sent from NS to xdrip's NS-Follower but just the sgv's are read / extracted correctly by the EntryProcessor.

Question: is this behaviour intended or can we change it?
i'm really new to xdip and could not predict the impact on changing this behaviour.
My first guess would be to evaluate the type and create BloodTest records from them. BUT i can't predict if this will produce some kind of (unwanted) side effects.....

From your point of view:
does this change makes sense?

kind regards,
